title: Vertex AI gateway config fields that are not strings need a string-accepting before-validator for server auth_config
answers: vertex_anthropic_betas list fails validation when set through the gateway API
auth_config value for a Vertex list option is rejected at first request
How do I pass a list option to a Vertex endpoint created via the REST API?
gateway endpoint Vertex config validation error on request not on create
body:
Invariant: server-side endpoint configs arrive through auth_config, which is map<string, string> in the service proto, so a non-string VertexAIConfig field (such as a list) can only arrive as a string.
Enforced by: mlflow/gateway/config.py:VertexAIConfig.validate_vertex_anthropic_betas (mode="before") splits a comma-separated string, strips whitespace and drops empties, so "" yields []; lists pass through unchanged for YAML configs.
Wiring: mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:_build_endpoint_config must read the key from auth_config and pass it into VertexAIConfig.
Breaks if skipped: every string form fails validation, and the error is raised when the first request hits the endpoint rather than when the endpoint is created.
Applies: adding any list or non-string field to VertexAIConfig that is set through auth_config; use the same comma-separated convention as the allowed hosts/origins settings.
applies: VertexAIConfig fields exposed through auth_config in the gateway server API; YAML-only configs can keep native lists.
says: Creating an endpoint through the gateway API crashes on the first request with validation errors.
Setting list options via the gateway REST API fails validation during model queries.
Allow passing comma-separated values for list configurations when creating endpoints through the API.
Support configuring non-string endpoint settings using string parameters in the server management service.
search: Non-string fields in VertexAIConfig exposed through server auth_config require a before-validator to parse string representations into native types. Because server-side endpoint configs pass through auth_config as map<string, string>, fields like vertex_anthropic_betas must parse comma-separated strings into lists. In mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:_build_endpoint_config, the key must be read from auth_config and passed to VertexAIConfig. Without this validator, validation fails upon receiving the first request rather than at endpoint creation time.
